concepts.name: Components as UI building blocks
concepts.summary: Explain that a React UI is built from reusable components, each a function that returns a description of part of the screen.

concepts.name: JSX syntax rules
concepts.summary: Write JSX with a single root element, closed tags, className, and curly braces for embedding JavaScript expressions.

concepts.name: Props for passing data
concepts.summary: Understand that props are read-only inputs passed from a parent to a child component to customise its output.

concepts.name: Rendering component trees
concepts.summary: Recall that components are nested to form a tree and that the root is mounted into a DOM node to display the app.

concepts.name: Conditional rendering with expressions
concepts.summary: Show or hide JSX using if statements, ternaries and the logical AND operator.

concepts.name: Rendering lists with map
concepts.summary: Turn an array of data into a list of elements using map and understand that each item needs a key.

misconceptions.text: JSX is HTML that the browser reads directly.
A child component can change the props it receives.
Component names can start with a lowercase letter and still be treated as components.

concepts.name: State with useState
concepts.summary: Add state to a function component, read it and update it with the setter so the component re-renders.

concepts.name: Event handlers
concepts.summary: Attach handler functions to elements via props such as onClick and onChange, passing the function rather than calling it.

concepts.name: Controlled form inputs
concepts.summary: Bind an input's value to state and update it in onChange so React is the source of truth for the form.

concepts.name: Keys for list items
concepts.summary: Choose stable, unique keys from the data so React can match list items between renders.

concepts.name: Lifting state up
concepts.summary: Move state to the closest common parent of components that need it and pass it down with props and callbacks.

concepts.name: Immutable state updates
aliases: updating objects and arrays in state
concepts.summary: Update object and array state by creating new copies with spread, map and filter instead of mutating.

concepts.name: Class components and lifecycle
concepts.summary: Read a class component with this.props, this.state, setState and basic lifecycle methods and map it to the function equivalent.

misconceptions.text: Calling the state setter changes the state variable immediately within the current function run.
Writing onClick={handle()} attaches the handler to the click.
Using the array index as key is always fine.

concepts.name: Rendering and re-rendering cycle
concepts.summary: Analyse when and why components re-render, distinguishing the render phase from the commit to the DOM.

concepts.name: Effects with useEffect
concepts.summary: Use effects to synchronise a component with external systems, with correct dependency arrays and cleanup functions.

concepts.name: Virtual DOM reconciliation
concepts.summary: Explain how React diffs successive element trees by type and key to apply minimal DOM updates.

concepts.name: State batching and updater functions
concepts.summary: Reason about state as a per-render snapshot and use updater functions when the next value depends on the previous one.

concepts.name: Component composition with children
concepts.summary: Design flexible components that accept children and other elements as props instead of relying on inheritance.

concepts.name: Custom hooks for reuse
concepts.summary: Extract stateful logic shared by components into custom hooks that follow the rules of hooks.

concepts.name: Refs and DOM access
concepts.summary: Use refs for DOM nodes and mutable values that do not affect rendering, and know when not to.

concepts.name: Deciding where state lives
concepts.summary: Decide what is state versus derived data and structure state to avoid duplication and contradiction.

misconceptions.text: The virtual DOM makes React faster than direct DOM manipulation in every case.
A re-render means the browser DOM is fully rebuilt.
An effect with an empty dependency array is the right place for any logic, and omitting dependencies is harmless.

concepts.name: Context for shared data
concepts.summary: Evaluate when context avoids prop drilling and analyse how its updates re-render consumers.

concepts.name: Reducer-based state management
concepts.summary: Model complex state transitions as actions and a pure reducer and choose it over multiple useState calls.

concepts.name: Render performance optimisation
concepts.summary: Judge when memoisation pays off, diagnose needless re-renders with profiling and avoid premature optimisation.

concepts.name: Data fetching in effects
concepts.summary: Handle loading, error and race conditions when fetching data, with cancellation or ignore flags.

concepts.name: Component API design
concepts.summary: Evaluate and shape component interfaces using compound components, render props and controlled versus uncontrolled patterns.

concepts.name: Error boundaries and Suspense
concepts.summary: Contain rendering failures with error boundaries and split code with lazy and Suspense fallbacks.

concepts.name: Testing components by behaviour
concepts.summary: Evaluate tests that exercise components through user-visible behaviour rather than implementation details.

misconceptions.text: Wrapping every component in memo and every function in useCallback always improves performance.
Context is a full state management replacement that never causes extra re-renders.
Error boundaries catch errors thrown in event handlers and async code.

concepts.name: Architecture of large React apps
concepts.summary: Design the structure of a large single-page app, including module boundaries, routing and state ownership.

concepts.name: State management strategy selection
concepts.summary: Evaluate trade-offs between local state, context, external stores and server-state caching for a given application.

concepts.name: Concurrent rendering model
concepts.summary: Assess how interruptible rendering, transitions and deferred values affect responsiveness and component purity requirements.

concepts.name: Server rendering and hydration
concepts.summary: Evaluate client, server and hybrid rendering strategies and their effects on hydration, performance and complexity.

concepts.name: Design system component libraries
concepts.summary: Create a reusable, accessible, well-typed component library with stable APIs and versioning.

concepts.name: Performance and accessibility auditing
concepts.summary: Judge an app's rendering performance and accessibility with profiling data and audits and prioritise fixes.

concepts.name: Migration and refactoring strategy
concepts.summary: Plan incremental migration of class-based or legacy codebases to modern patterns with controlled risk.

misconceptions.text: A single global store is the best place for all application state.
Server rendering always improves performance and removes the need for client-side work.
Concurrent features make rendering faster by running code on parallel threads.
